gaps.explanation: Governmental funds statement p5 prints 'Lease issuance' 224,525 in the General Fund column (Total 224,525, p6) = JSON debt_proceeds. The General Fund budgetary schedule p13 does not print it, so it is not in detail: add it from the statement General Fund column. The schedule_total 32,188 is not debt: it is detail[13] 'Proceeds from sale of capital assets' 18,500 (General, p13) + detail[26] 13,688 (Street, p15), which the statement records in other_financing (Proceeds from sale of capital asset 32,188, p6) and which the gap check counts here only because the label says 'Proceeds'. After the add the debt lines in detail = 224,525 = statement (the gap check will still show 224,525 + 32,188 = 256,713 until it stops counting sale-of-asset proceeds as debt).
